household: One adult, no children, living in Austin

benchmarks.published: HUD FY 2027: $1,530 gross rent for one bedroom; $1,817 for two.
benchmarks.use: The baseline one-bedroom picture totals $1,530 including its utility allowance. Other home levels are planning choices.

benchmarks.published: Austin metro median closed sale: $421,000, September 2026. Freddie Mac 30-year rate: 7.40%, October 15.
benchmarks.use: Price and rate anchors are sourced. Taxes, insurance, HOA, maintenance, closing costs, and PMI are editable assumptions. A median sale is not a promise of a particular house.

benchmarks.published: MIT Travis County 2026 basic-needs reference: food about $347/month and medical about $256/month.
benchmarks.use: Frugal groceries now use $350, with higher choices for variety and convenience. The health allowance is an assumption. A basic-needs budget is not a leisure-and-savings lifestyle.

benchmarks.published: Experian Q2 2026 national loan averages: used 11.19%; new 6.35%.
benchmarks.use: New picture choices use these APRs. Car prices, insurance, fuel, parking, and maintenance remain scenarios. A paid-off car includes an allowance for replacement. Down payments are separate from monthly spending.

benchmarks.published: CapMetro local calendar-month fare: $41.25. Rail/Express commuter fare: $96.25. Fare change announced for January 10, 2027.
benchmarks.use: The lowest-cost transit choice uses local service, plus an assumed rides budget. It does not include unlimited commuter rail or guarantee a workable route.

benchmarks.published: Freddie Mac’s broad PMI guide is $30–$70/month per $100,000 borrowed.
benchmarks.use: Below 20% down, the model now adds PMI. Default 0.6% annually equals $50/month per $100,000. This is a midpoint estimate, not an insurance quote.

benchmarks.published: No source establishes a universal salary-to-brand, holiday, or restaurant lifestyle.
benchmarks.use: These are chosen spending baskets, not measured Austin price bands. Dinner amounts include assumed tax and tip. Weekly dinners convert at 52/12 weeks per month.
